findings.skin: The preinst legacy bridge gate rejects a direct 9.50-r12.2 replacement. With actual opkg/libsolv it leaves the new identity half-installed and the old status query empty; a second force reinstall passes. Force flags do not fix the first attempt.
findings.piconhub: The minimal 5.0.240904 original-plugin replacement passes with and without force flags; the reported receiver-specific first failure is not reproduced.
findings.gsu: Current main updater reviewed at 40f1a615d15e7b24c8cccee217bab3dacef7d55c. It uses a guarded r93 identity transition with a verified recovery package and rollback. No GSU runtime change made.
findings.success_checks: Both product updaters previously relied on insufficient final evidence: skin exit code plus version, PiconHub exit code. New checks validate critical payload and exact fully installed package status.

fix.direct_r12: Admit only upgrade 9.50-r12.2 with exact owner-supplied postrm SHA-256 and no prerm; known postrm skips upgrade cleanup. Retain the prepared-transition gate for unknown scripts or invocations.
fix.payload_checks: Postinst validates critical files before returning success; updater validates complete package status after opkg exits. No logs or new background jobs.
